title: AI's Journey: From Responders to Autonomous Thinkers
description: The evolution of AI reasoning has progressed from merely responding to requests to achieving self-reflection and self-initiation of actions, marking significant strides towards autonomy. This journey, coupled with stages of human interaction from "in-the-loop" to "autonomous operation," aims to create sophisticated systems capable of reliable collaboration with humans across various applications.

title: "From Simple Queries to AI with World Models"
description: The evolution of chatbots and AI assistants showcases significant advancements, transitioning from simple text-based responders to sophisticated systems with capabilities like multi-turn and contextual conversations, persistent memory, and multimodal reasoning. These developments have enhanced their ability to interact naturally with users, integrate real-time and synthesized knowledge, and even predict real-world scenarios, making them essential tools in everyday life.
